questions.q: Which philosopher argued humans were naturally good and harmed by agriculture?
questions.why: Rousseau claimed humans are inherently good and agriculture corrupts them.

questions.q: What event in the 15th century caused a labor shortage that led Europeans to consider slavery?
questions.why: The Black Death killed over a third of Europe's population, creating a labor shortage.

questions.q: Which principle did early kings use to maintain authority by threatening punishment?
questions.why: Kings relied on control of violence to punish and reward subjects.

questions.q: Which group in northern California shared possessions and had no private property?
questions.why: Northern California inhabitants lived communally without private property.

questions.q: What was Thomas Hobbes's view of human nature?
questions.why: Hobbes believed humans were inherently evil and selfish.
